thread.title: Special Participation E - Gemini Pro 3 on State Space Models (Using lecture notes as ground truth)
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>I used Gemini pro 3 to walk me through the training and inference of state space models. I used lecture notes to compare its external knowledge with and then I used itself to check whether there were any hallucinations within the model itself. Enjoy :)  </paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/pTrIcckjhzkeqb97aubGKGFd" filename="SSM-Gemini.pdf"/></document>
